comparison.position: 显式prefix树上结果分歧前沿、边界调制异方差RTS/LMMSE与最小吸收前沿后的零和log长度优势；本地CPU核验Eq3/5–10，不运行LLM/RL。
comparison.tradeoff: OpCredit按操作上下文匹配支持集得到BOC、按训练答案邻域得到FTC；BRIAR的固定经验方差和树全局后验并非这些图语义信号。两者均须隔离训练信用与被评测Agent输入，无同预算能力比较。

analysis.title: 局部信用既可能来自匹配轨迹，也可能来自全局树后验
analysis.body: 实际重读OpCredit当前README：BOC去重的是匹配上下文下的轨迹支持集，FTC比较操作局部前沿，不把训练gold输入actor。BRIAR将已采样prefix树视为Gaussian状态空间，向上信息和向下后验融合使兄弟分支共同影响信用；dense covariance是独立数值参考。Eq5的2.2倍和长度项并不逐边硬性满足martingale方差上界，suffix token排除也不保证共享参数更新后prefix行为不变。CPU等价检查只能支持该数值组件，完整16/32A100矩阵成本过高不复现。

question.question: 相同实体的两条轨迹可以直接合并成BRIAR共享prefix吗？
question.answer: 不可以。共享prefix要求完整可见历史相同；OpCredit也需上下文匹配，实体相同不代表访问集合、预算和阶段相同。忽略历史会把不同条件概率和训练信用混为一谈。
question.example: 教学例：一条轨迹已访问实体A且只余1步，另一条尚未访问且余3步；即使当前实体相同，其续写分布也不同，不能仅用实体ID共用posterior。

update.summary: 实际重读OpCredit README并对照BRIAR固定v1 Eq3/5–10、附B/C，新增匹配操作支持集与Gaussian树后验的区别；纠正硬方差包络/共享参数prefix不变的过强解读。BRIAR仅CPU组件，完整多卡RL成本DONE，不据此比较Agent能力。

comparison.position: Outcome-bifurcation frontier, boundary-modulated heteroscedastic RTS/LMMSE and zero-sum log-length advantages after minimal absorption. CPU code checks Eqs.3/5–10, not LLM/RL.
comparison.tradeoff: OpCredit uses context-matched supports for BOC and training-side answer neighborhoods for FTC. BRIAR's empirical edge variances and global tree posterior are not those graph-semantic signals. Both must separate training credit from agent inputs; no matched-budget capability comparison exists.

analysis.title: Local credit can come from matched trajectories or a global tree posterior
analysis.body: Re-reading OpCredit confirms deduplicated context-matched BOC supports and operation-local FTC frontiers, without gold in actor inputs. BRIAR treats a sampled prefix tree as a Gaussian state-space model; upward information and downward smoothing transmit sibling evidence. Dense covariance is an independent numerical reference. Equation5's2.2 factor and length term do not impose a hard martingale variance bound, and excluding prefix-token loss does not freeze shared-parameter prefix behavior. CPU equivalence only supports the numerical component; the full16/32-A100 matrix is too expensive.

question.question: Can trajectories at the same entity be merged into a shared BRIAR prefix?
question.answer: No. Full visible histories must match. OpCredit likewise needs context matching: identical entities do not imply identical visited sets, budgets or phases. Ignoring history conflates conditional probabilities and credit.
question.example: Teaching example: one trajectory has visitedA with one step left; another has not and has three steps left. Their continuation distributions differ despite the same current entity.

english.update: Re-read OpCredit against fixed-v1 BRIAR Eqs.3/5–10 and AppendicesB/C. Added matched supports versus Gaussian posteriors and corrected hard-envelope/shared-parameter-invariance overclaims. BRIAR is CPU components only; full multi-GPU RL is high-cost review DONE, not agent-capability comparison.

comparison.position: 固定atomic历史、当前policy/PCA/GMM重聚类、正priority与曝光欠额、选中簇预算保护，再以累计reward方差2/4/16晋级；外部表示不以task标签替代。
comparison.tradeoff: RAIL以shadow-to-live干预后的recoverability收益学习contextual bandit，控制帮助位置和方式；FEAST分配学习机会与计算，未学习干预策略。簇内variance selector单独存在不等于FEAST，旧RAIL mini-suite亦不构成共同能力对照。

analysis.title: 保护机会不同于学习如何救回失败轨迹
analysis.body: 实际重读RAIL README，其定义对象为干预状态/动作与恢复收益。FEAST处理的是内生学习信号导致的长期机会分配；每个原子的m/u/trend/shortfall不因当前policy重聚类而重置。共同pilot给prompt等权反馈，全部rollout计入曝光，selected cluster预算不可在后续晋级时跨簇流走。本地运行真实KMeans++/PCA/GMM-EM/BIC、history和quota组件，但随机向量及Bernoulli callback只作诊断，不是LLM或公平性能力实验。最小单臂约6.07A100小时不代表完整多臂矩阵可负担。

question.question: 若一簇本轮pilot全部失败，能否把其余预算挪给别簇的高方差题？
question.answer: 在FEAST预留预算机制中不能。该簇既已选中，就保有固定Bc；内部晋级仍按原始累计reward方差执行。否则删掉的是跨簇机会保护，不是等价加速。
question.example: 教学例：逻辑簇和数学簇各预留256条；逻辑pilot全0时仍用稳定并列晋级完成其256条，不能借此给数学簇额外128条。

update.summary: 实际重读RAIL README并对照FEAST固定v1 Section4/AppendixA.2–A.3，新增recoverability干预与持久机会/配额保护的区别，保留pilot等权、全部曝光和聚类不重置历史的边界。CPU组件不作学习能力比较，完整LLM矩阵成本DONE。

comparison.position: Persistent atomic histories, current-policy PCA/GMM regrouping, positive priorities/shortfalls, cluster reservations and cumulative-variance2/4/16 promotion. External representations are not replaced with task labels.
comparison.tradeoff: RAIL learns a shadow-to-live contextual bandit from intervention recoverability, controlling where/how to help. FEAST allocates opportunity and compute without learning interventions. A variance selector alone is not FEAST; the old RAIL mini-suite is not a common capability comparison.

analysis.title: Protecting opportunity differs from learning how to recover a failing trajectory
analysis.body: The current RAIL README defines intervention states/actions and recovery gains. FEAST addresses endogenous signals and long-run opportunity: atomic attainment, disagreement, trend and shortfall survive policy-adaptive regrouping. Common pilots give prompt-equal feedback, every rollout counts as exposure, and reserved compute cannot migrate between clusters. Local code runs actual KMeans++, PCA, GMM-EM/BIC, histories and quotas, but random vectors and Bernoulli callbacks remain diagnostics, not LLM or fairness-capability experiments. A6.07-A100-hour minimum arm does not make the complete matrix affordable.

question.question: Can an all-failing pilot cluster give its remaining budget to another cluster's high-variance prompts?
question.answer: Not under FEAST reservations. Once selected, the cluster retains its fixed budget and promotes internally using cumulative raw-reward variance. Reallocation removes cross-cluster protection rather than providing an equivalent acceleration.
question.example: Teaching example: logic and mathematics each reserve256 trajectories. All-zero logic pilots still complete its256 through stable promotion ties; mathematics cannot take an extra128.

english.update: Re-read RAIL against fixed-v1 FEAST Section4 and AppendicesA.2–A.3. Added recoverability interventions versus persistent opportunities/quotas, preserving pilot-equal feedback, full exposure and non-resetting histories. CPU components do not rank learning ability; full LLM experiments are high-cost review DONE.

comparison.position: 学生roll-in扩历史，teacher continuation验证、后见证据选turn与新响应confidence gate联合决定prefix replay；仍采用教师token reverse KL。仅review-only。
comparison.tradeoff: TreeOPSD将共享树信用映射为冻结有界Bernoulli target以限制重复更新；CARE-OPD改变历史支持、回放turn和更新资格，不规定相同有限target。完成轨迹可用于训练selector，但未来结果不得暴露给学生。

analysis.title: 后见选择样本不是构造有界蒸馏目标
analysis.body: 实际重读TreeOPSD README，树共享要求完整历史、叶奖励使用sample std，冻结Bernoulli目标在达到和越过目标时分别零梯度与反向。CARE-OPD的定义性变化发生在collection/replay allocation/response acceptance；后见teacher看完整执行记录，学生只看原prefix，临时标识与未来证据必须剥离。用固定前40%或仅confidence gate会删掉关键selector，不能称忠实核心。原文32H200、128K/150turn和大规模SWE执行超预算，review-only终态，不建本地指标或evolve。

question.question: 后见选择了一个teacher turn，是否就给学生设定了有限更新终点？
question.answer: 没有。CARE-OPD只是决定从哪个prefix生成新响应并是否蒸馏，其教师token reverse KL与TreeOPSD的冻结Bernoulli目标不同；选择本身既不等于目标半径，也不保证overshoot控制。
question.example: 教学例：把第60轮修复选进replay只规定采样位置；TreeOPSD则还给相对旧策略的turn分数一个明确target，达到后梯度归零。

update.summary: 实际重读TreeOPSD README与CARE-OPD固定v1 Section3/AppendixB，增加有界目标与后见样本分配的区分、未来证据隔离要求及不可用固定selector代替的界线。CARE-OPD完整32H200流程成本过高不复现，review DONE；无本地代码/指标/GPU/evolve。

comparison.position: Student roll-ins broaden history, verified teacher continuations and hindsight evidence select turns, and confidence gates fresh student responses. Teacher-token reverse KL remains; review-only locally.
comparison.tradeoff: TreeOPSD maps shared-tree credit into frozen bounded Bernoulli targets to limit repeated updates. CARE-OPD changes history support, replay turns and response eligibility without imposing the same finite target. Completed trajectories may inform the training selector, never expose future evidence to students.

analysis.title: Hindsight sample selection is not a bounded distillation target
analysis.body: The current TreeOPSD README requires full shared histories, sample-standardized leaf rewards and frozen Bernoulli targets with zero/overshoot-reversing gradients. CARE-OPD changes collection, allocation and acceptance. Its hindsight teacher sees complete execution evidence; students see only original prefixes after removing identifiers and future evidence. A fixed first40% selector or confidence gate alone removes a defining model and is not faithful reproduction. The32-H200,128K-context,150-turn SWE workflow exceeds budget, remaining terminal review-only with no local metrics or Evolve.

question.question: Does selecting a teacher turn establish a finite student update endpoint?
question.answer: No. CARE-OPD chooses a prefix for fresh responses and decides whether to distill them. Teacher-token reverse KL differs from TreeOPSD's frozen Bernoulli target; selection alone provides neither a target radius nor overshoot control.
question.example: Teaching example: replaying a repair at turn60 specifies a sampling location. TreeOPSD additionally assigns a target to the turn score relative to old policy, with zero gradient at that target.

english.update: Re-read TreeOPSD and fixed-v1 CARE-OPD Section3/AppendixB. Added bounded targets versus hindsight allocation, future-evidence isolation and the non-equivalence of fixed selectors. Full32-H200 CARE-OPD is too expensive and not reproduced, review DONE; no local code, metrics, GPU or Evolve.
